# opencode-web-preview

Chinese version: [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)

opencode-web-preview adds managed local frontend previews to OpenCode, but it only works together with OpenCode Studio because Studio owns preview session storage, proxy routing, and hosted preview runtime.

## Why Teams Use Web Preview

- Start, stop, restart, and inspect local frontend previews from an OpenCode chat session.
- Keep preview session records, logs, and runtime state in OpenCode Studio so the agent and UI share one source of truth.
- Generate stable `proxyBasePath` values for Studio-hosted iframe, static asset, and HMR traffic.
- Discover reachable loopback dev URLs for common frontend ports and environment conventions.

## Installation

Add the plugin to your OpenCode config file `opencode.json`:

- Unix/macOS: `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`
- Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\\.config\\opencode\\opencode.json` (for example: `C:\\Users\\<your-user>\\.config\\opencode\\opencode.json`)

```jsonc
{
  "plugin": ["opencode-web-preview"]
}
```

OpenCode installs npm plugins automatically when the session starts.

## Required Pairing: OpenCode Studio

opencode-web-preview is a Studio companion plugin, not a standalone workflow.

- Learn more: [opencode-studio](https://github.com/canxin121/opencode-studio)
- Studio persists preview sessions and exposes the HTTP APIs this plugin calls.
- When OpenCode is launched by Studio, Studio injects:
  - `OPENCODE_STUDIO_BASE_URL`
  - `OPENCODE_STUDIO_UI_AUTH_TOKEN` (only when Studio UI auth is enabled)
- If those env vars are missing, every action except `help` fails.

## Quick Start with Natural Language

Example prompts:

```text
1. Use web_preview_helper to start a managed preview for this frontend workspace.
2. Use web_preview_helper to list Studio preview sessions and tell me which preview is running.
3. Use web_preview_helper to restart preview session pv_example on port 5173.
```

## OpenCode Studio Experience

web_preview_helper becomes most useful inside OpenCode Studio:

- Session lifecycle control backed by Studio APIs (`create`, `update`, `start`, `stop`, `status`, `list`).
- Shared preview metadata so Studio UI and the agent stay aligned on `id`, `port`, `targetUrl`, and logs.
- Proxy-safe preview hosting with a stable `/api/workspace/preview/s/{id}/` base path.
- Loopback-only discovery for safer local preview handoff during frontend work.

If you want agents to manage local frontend previews reliably, OpenCode Studio is the required runtime and the recommended control surface.

## Details

Detailed action contracts, discovery rules, Studio API payloads, and verification commands are documented in `DETAIL.md`.

# opencode-web-preview

英文版：[README.md](README.md)

opencode-web-preview 为 OpenCode 增加托管式本地前端预览能力，但它必须与 OpenCode Studio 配合使用，因为预览会话存储、代理路由和托管运行时都由 Studio 负责。

## 为什么选择 Web Preview

- 直接在 OpenCode 对话中启动、停止、重启并查看本地前端预览。
- 将预览会话记录、日志和运行状态统一保存在 OpenCode Studio 中，让 UI 与 agent 共享同一份事实来源。
- 生成稳定的 `proxyBasePath`，方便 Studio 承载 iframe、静态资源和 HMR 流量。
- 按常见前端端口与环境变量约定发现可访问的 loopback 开发地址。

## 安装

把插件加入你的 OpenCode 配置文件 `opencode.json`：

- Unix/macOS：`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`
- Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\\.config\\opencode\\opencode.json`（例如：`C:\\Users\\<your-user>\\.config\\opencode\\opencode.json`）

```jsonc
{
  "plugin": ["opencode-web-preview"]
}
```

OpenCode 会在会话启动时自动安装 npm 插件。

## 必须与 OpenCode Studio 搭配使用

opencode-web-preview 是一个 Studio 配套插件，不能脱离 Studio 单独使用。

- 了解 Studio： [opencode-studio](https://github.com/canxin121/opencode-studio)
- 预览会话的持久化存储和 HTTP API 都由 Studio 提供。
- 当 OpenCode 由 Studio 启动时，Studio 会自动注入：
  - `OPENCODE_STUDIO_BASE_URL`
  - `OPENCODE_STUDIO_UI_AUTH_TOKEN`（仅在 Studio UI 开启鉴权时提供）
- 如果缺少这些环境变量，除 `help` 之外的所有动作都会失败。

## 自然语言快速开始

示例提示词：

```text
1. 使用 web_preview_helper 为当前前端工作区启动一个托管预览。
2. 使用 web_preview_helper 列出 Studio 中的预览会话，并告诉我哪个正在运行。
3. 使用 web_preview_helper 在 5173 端口重启预览会话 pv_example。
```

## OpenCode Studio 集成体验

web_preview_helper 在 OpenCode Studio 中最有价值：

- 通过 Studio API 管理会话生命周期（`create`、`update`、`start`、`stop`、`status`、`list`）。
- 让 Studio UI 与 agent 共享 `id`、`port`、`targetUrl`、日志等预览元数据。
- 使用稳定的 `/api/workspace/preview/s/{id}/` 路径安全承载代理预览。
- 仅允许 loopback 发现，降低本地前端预览交接时的风险。

如果你希望 agent 稳定管理本地前端预览，那么 OpenCode Studio 既是必需运行时，也是最推荐的控制界面。

# opencode-web-preview Details

## Tool

- Tool name: `web_preview_helper`

## Requirements

- OpenCode Studio must be running.
- This plugin is intended to run only when OpenCode is launched by Studio.
- Studio injects:
  - `OPENCODE_STUDIO_BASE_URL` (or `OPENCODE_STUDIO_URL`)
  - `OPENCODE_STUDIO_UI_AUTH_TOKEN` (or `OPENCODE_STUDIO_AUTH_TOKEN` when available)
- All actions except `help` require the Studio environment above.

## Actions

- `help`: show help text.
- `host.start`: create or update a Studio preview session and start it.
- `host.stop`: stop a Studio preview session by `id`.
- `host.restart`: stop then start a Studio preview session by `id`.
- `host.status`: fetch the latest session record from Studio by `id`.
- `sessions.list`: list preview sessions from Studio.
- `discover`: probe candidate URLs and return the first reachable loopback URL without persisting state.

## Common Arguments

- `action` (required): one of the actions above.
- `id` (optional): target preview session id. Required for `host.stop`, `host.restart`, and `host.status`.
- `port` (optional): preferred port for `host.start` / `host.restart`; also used as a discovery hint.
- `command` (optional): explicit command to run for `host.start` / `host.restart`.
- `args` (optional): explicit argv list for `command`.
- `url` (optional): explicit URL candidate for `discover`.

## Discovery Rules

`discover` tries candidates in this order:

1. Explicit `url`.
2. Environment variables: `VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL`, `DEV_SERVER_URL`, `PREVIEW_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`, `NUXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`.
3. Explicit `port` as `http://127.0.0.1:<port>`.
4. Default ports on `127.0.0.1` and `localhost`: `5173`, `3000`, `4173`, `8080`, `4200`, `4321`.

Only loopback `http` / `https` targets are accepted.

## Hosting Rules

- Script resolution order: `dev` -> `start` -> `preview` from `package.json`.
- Package manager detection uses `packageManager` or common lockfiles (`bun`, `pnpm`, `yarn`, `npm`).
- Extra args always include `--host 127.0.0.1`.
- Vite projects also receive `--strictPort --base <proxyBasePath> --port <port>`.
- Other frameworks receive `--port <port>`.
- `host.stop`, `host.restart`, and `host.status` never choose a session implicitly; pass `id` explicitly.

## Studio API Contract

The plugin talks to Studio's HTTP API:

- `GET /api/workspace/preview/sessions`
- `GET /api/workspace/preview/sessions/{id}`
- `POST /api/workspace/preview/sessions`
- `PUT /api/workspace/preview/sessions/{id}`
- `POST /api/workspace/preview/sessions/{id}/start`
- `POST /api/workspace/preview/sessions/{id}/stop`

Studio session records use camelCase JSON fields. Example:

```json
{
  "id": "pv_m8m0d7_abc123def0",
  "directory": "/workspace/app",
  "runDirectory": "/workspace/app",
  "opencodeSessionId": "sess_123",
  "state": "running",
  "proxyBasePath": "/api/workspace/preview/s/pv_m8m0d7_abc123def0/",
  "targetUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:5173/api/workspace/preview/s/pv_m8m0d7_abc123def0/",
  "pid": 45678,
  "port": 5173,
  "command": "bun",
  "args": [
    "run",
    "dev",
    "--",
    "--host",
    "127.0.0.1",
    "--strictPort",
    "--base",
    "/api/workspace/preview/s/pv_m8m0d7_abc123def0/",
    "--port",
    "5173"
  ],
  "logsPath": "/home/user/.config/opencode-studio/workspace-preview/logs/pv_m8m0d7_abc123def0.log",
  "updatedAt": 1710000000500
}
```

## Verification

- `bun run preview:selfcheck`
- `bun run typecheck`
